history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young woman with vibrant, long, wavy orange hair stands in the foreground, looking directly at the camera with a soft, alluring expression. She has light skin with a few specks of glitter on her cheek and under her eye. She is wearing a bright yellow tank top with a graphic design of a silhouetted figure surrounded by stars, and text that reads "ICE BY MY BABY". Underneath the tank top, she wears a white mesh undershirt, and her lower half is clad in distressed denim jeans with white suspenders. Her hands are casually placed in her front pockets. The background appears to be an outdoor setting, possibly a parking lot or a paved area with white markings, behind which are buildings with colorful facades (yellow and blue) and lush green palm trees and foliage. The lighting is bright and airy, suggesting a sunny day, with a soft, slightly diffused quality that gives the image a dreamy, summery feel. The overall color palette is dominated by warm tones – the orange of her hair, the yellow of her top, and the bright hues of the background buildings – contrasted with the cool blue of her jeans. The mood is youthful, playful, and fashionable, evoking a sense of carefree summer vibes. The style is reminiscent of K-pop or J-pop visual aesthetics, with a focus on vibrant colors and stylish outfits.
